PowerShell($j = Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $proj = $j.projects.'c:/Development/OU/navigate'; if \($proj.mcpServers\) { "Current mcpServers in this project:"; $proj.mcpServers | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } else { "no mcpServers configured for this project" }; "---"; "User-level scope check:"; $u = $j.projects.'C:/Users/DavidCiocoiu'; if \($u.mcpServers\) { $u.mcpServers | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } else { "none" })
